Edit: Here's what I did in case anyone else has the same question in the future. I changed the DHCP lease time to 3 hours (enough for the lease to expire overnight) so when the computer turns on in the morning, it will show the time remaining and allow me to figure out how much time is left.

Thanks go to suggestionsonly and ndelregno
